scope: Bounded source-text assertions from the humidifier, UPS battery exhaust fan, bathroom exhaust fan, and elevator machine room sequences of operation on MI742 (source PDF page 69). These assertions preserve explicit logic and source spellings; they do not claim the rest of the source document is sequence-audited.
coordinate_system: Displayed PDF page, points, top-left origin; 2448 x 1584.
